## English

### Fixed

- Narrowed the column-mapping regex to prevent CamelCase names from incorrectly matching `foreign_key_or_integer`. In `mapper.py`, replaced `(?i).*_no$|.*_nbr$|.*[A-Z]no$|.*[A-Z]nbr$` with `.*_no$|.*_nbr$`.
- Removed `plugins/` from the hatchling sdist exclusion list in `pyproject.toml` so the published source package includes the plugins directory.

## 中文

### 修复

- 收窄列映射正则表达式，避免 CamelCase 列名被错误匹配为 `foreign_key_or_integer`。`mapper.py` 中的 `(?i).*_no$|.*_nbr$|.*[A-Z]no$|.*[A-Z]nbr$` 替换为 `.*_no$|.*_nbr$`。
- 从 `pyproject.toml` 的 hatchling sdist 排除列表移除 `plugins/`，使发布的源码包包含插件目录。
